Arista Networks business model transition subscription software CloudVision 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：Arista 以直銷團隊加通路夥伴（經銷商、VAR、系統整合商、OEM）銷售；夥伴通常先收到終端客戶訂單才向 Arista 下單，且一般不持有庫存。未見通路結構性改制的揭露。
findings.excerpt: We market and sell our products through our direct sales force and in partnership with our channel partners, including distributors, value-added resellers, systems integrators and original equipment manufacturer ("OEM") partners.

findings.claim: Q4 2025 財報電話會議：訂閱型網路服務與軟體（A-Care、CloudVision 等）約占營收 17%，仍為少數；第三方整理稱 CloudVision Lite as-a-Service SKU 於 2026-03-02 停售。
findings.source: Arista Q4 2025 earnings call transcript (equibles.com 轉錄)
findings.excerpt: Arista's subscription-based network services and software revenue contributed approximately 17%.

findings.claim: 第三方評論稱 Arista 推進園區／分支（含 VeloCloud SD-WAN）需強化通路策略，COO Todd Nightingale 負責擴大通路；此為評論而非公司披露。

note: 未找到 D2C 或去中介化證據；訂閱占比與通路皆為漸進變化，非結構性轉移的一手證據。
